note: The draft ordinance adopted on 24 July 2026 formalises the village-level 'cahier de recensement', the register from which family record books are issued; the communiqué does not say how it is kept and says nothing of births or deaths registered at civil status centres. The cahier is classed identity as a population listing, on the document's one-line description.
